articles.summary: Kampala, Uganda – August 28, 2024: Flutterwave, a leading payments technology company, has received a Payment Systems Operator (PSO) license from the Bank of Uganda. This marks a key milestone in Flutterwave’s expansion across Africa, adding Uganda to its growing list of countries where it operates. articles.title: Flutterwave Expands African Footprint with Payment Systems License in Uganda
